title: Spec Corpus Install Record
description: Thin install record stored at .spec-corpus/install.json to track the active corpus snapshot in a consumer project.

layoutVersion.description: Install layout version. v1 uses snapshots; v2 uses flat .spec-corpus root.

corpusPackageName.description: npm package name of the corpus package (e.g. "@spec-corpus/corpus").

corpusPackageVersion.description: Semver version of the installed corpus package.

corpusPackageIntegrity.description: npm integrity hash (sha512 format) of the installed corpus package.

cliPackageName.description: npm package name of the CLI tool (e.g. "spec-corpus").

cliPackageVersion.description: Semver version of the CLI tool that performed the install.

activeSnapshotVersion.description: Semver version of the currently active corpus snapshot.

activeSnapshotPath.description: [Deprecated in layoutVersion=2] Relative path to the active snapshot directory (e.g. ".spec-corpus/snapshots/0.1.0").

installedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the initial installation.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last update (optional).

installSource.description: How the corpus package was obtained.
